_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.login. Email + password sign-in form.
_meta.tone: Action-oriented. Translate the submit button as a single short verb where the language allows.

submit._use: Primary CTA on the login form. Keep short — fits inside the Lumia Button width.

submitLoading._use: Replaces the submit copy while the login request is in-flight.

forgotPasswordLink._use: Underlined inline link beside the submit button that takes users to /forgot-password.
